stem_book: In the cyclic process shown in the diagram (V on the vertical axis, P on the horizontal axis), the closed path is an ellipse that just fits between P₁ and P₂ and between V₁ and V₂. The magnitude of the work done is: (a) π((P₂ − P₁)/2)² (b) π((V₂ − V₁)/2)² (c) (π/4)(P₂ − P₁)(V₂ − V₁) (d) (π/4)(V₂ − V₁)²
reason: Figure drawn as a circle on unequal axes; stated as an ellipse inscribed in the P₁–P₂, V₁–V₂ box.
work: Ellipse area = π·((P₂ − P₁)/2)·((V₂ − V₁)/2) = (π/4)(P₂ − P₁)(V₂ − V₁)
